records.title: Behavioral Capacity Certificates for Quantized Language Models
records.reason: The primary contribution is a statistical complexity/certification framework; it does not establish serving latency or throughput improvements. Some independent-probe transfer bounds do not meet the stated 1% criterion.

records.title: Learning What to Remember: Long-horizon Counterfactual Memory Optimization
records.reason: The evaluation is document-level information extraction and does not measure LLM prefill latency, throughput, or serving memory. Shorter agent memory may reduce downstream context cost, but that inference benefit is not established here.

records.title: HybridCUA: Learning to Orchestrate GUI and CLI for Computer-Use Agents
records.reason: HybridCUA studies GUI/CLI orchestration for computer-use agents; its contribution is agent task orchestration rather than inference efficiency.

records.title: Prompts Live on an Arc: Gaussian Curricula in Fisher--Rao Coordinates for Rollout-Efficient GRPO
records.reason: ARCUS reduces GRPO training rollouts; the efficiency target is model-training data/rollouts, outside inference scope.

records.title: RS-OPSD: Reliable Privileged On-Policy-Self-Distillation for Ultra-High-Resolution Remote Sensing VQA
records.reason: RS-OPSD distills remote-sensing VQA capability into a vision model; its target is remote-sensing application and training, not general LLM inference systems.
